list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned; all single-player, no online trophies.

listSources.name: Press Start — full trophy list, 18 Nov 2026
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophy tracker (counts, via Sixshore)

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically. There is no shortcut: the list is long, not hard — trophy guides put a full run at roughly 200 hours, with the story itself around 50 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; Output Lag — platinum time ~200 h

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission of the game, so it unlocks in normal play and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is reported to disappear after the chapter, the one missable in the whole list.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; Output Lag — Chapter 1 meditation is missable

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From here both Jason and Lucia are playable, and most of the list opens up — several trophies need the two of them together.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; Output Lag — both playable from Chapter 2

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The robbery trophies start to open up in Chapters 3 and 4, so keep an eye on the crime section of the checklist as you go.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; Output Lag — robbery trophies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter. After it, the story moves toward the final mission and the free-roam clean-up begins.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. It is one of only two gold trophies in the list, and the 100% completion checklist only opens after the story, so do not expect the platinum to be close at this point. Keep a manual save before the final mission — there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; Output Lag — no mission replay, save before the final mission

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play and none of them can be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Sixshore — 12 story trophies, all hidden, none missable

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks in normal play; story trophies cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Sixshore — 12 story trophies, all hidden, none missable

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks in normal play; story trophies cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Sixshore — 12 story trophies, all hidden, none missable

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It unlocks in normal play; story trophies cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Sixshore — 12 story trophies, all hidden, none missable

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It unlocks in normal play; story trophies cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Sixshore — 12 story trophies, all hidden, none missable

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks in normal play; story trophies cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Sixshore — 12 story trophies, all hidden, none missable

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion checklist, which opens after the story. Both Sixshore and PowerPyx rank this the hardest trophy in the list; PowerPyx puts the checklist at roughly 60% of true completion, and it has to be finished after the story. Work through the roadmap stages in order and treat this as the last trophy before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Sixshore — hardest trophy, checklist opens after the story; EGamers — PowerPyx ranks it hardest

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count toward the running total. It is a grind, not a skill gate: fold stunts into your normal driving instead of farming them in one sitting, and check the in-game stats page to see your count.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; Sixshore — counts from PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, shooting range, hunting, racing, meditation and the stranger activities. One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win or finish them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 9 activity types

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the one silver most guides flag as a real skill check: take your time, learn each range's target pattern, and retry a challenge until the gold threshold clicks — there is no penalty for retrying.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 42 challenges

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations around Leonida. Learn each course's racing line before you push for the win, and remember the race is against the clock and the course, not just the other drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 14 locations

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins in the same one. Work through the race types across the map and tick them off in the checklist as you go.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 20 races

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types, so this also feeds Master of None — take the challenge when it appears and focus on steady reeling rather than speed.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to end. Any arcade cabinet counts, and a completed game also counts as trying that activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses; finish each character's strand when it appears rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Sixshore — side-character final missions; story trophies cannot be missed

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Sixshore — side-character final missions

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Sixshore — side-character final missions

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear on the map as you explore; talk to them, follow their strand to its end, and count it off here. Eight finished strands earn the silver.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; Sixshore — counts from PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Sixshore — side-character final missions

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Sixshore — side-character final missions

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: GTABase and PowerPyx both flag it, and Output Lag reports that Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter. Meditate at the balcony before Chapter 1 ends, then work through the other 17 spots. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — the game has no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: EGamers — GTABase and PowerPyx flag it as the only possibly missable trophy; Output Lag — Chapter 1 balcony disappears, no mission replay

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, track the animal, and take the shot — the trophy is for that one specific hunt, not for hunting in general.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Track your sets in the checklist and finish three of them — you do not need every set in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 3 sets

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Each location counts once, so keep moving — photograph new spots as you explore rather than repeating the same one, and use the map to find areas you have not covered yet.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 100 locations

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's scattered side objectives — stunts, feats and odd jobs that the game tracks for you. They accumulate across the whole playthrough, so check the challenges menu often and finish the easy ones as they appear.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 50 challenges

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Several trophies need Jason and Lucia together, so do the partner trophies in one session: grab a fast car, break line of sight, and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; Output Lag — several trophies need Jason and Lucia together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving between each one.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Driving or entering a new vehicle model counts it as discovered, so try everything you see — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all add to the count. The in-game vehicle log shows what you have found so far.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 100 vehicles

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends — a crowded shootout is the easiest place to line this up.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — get a plane off the ground without going through the normal departure. Steal a plane on the tarmac and take off; the trophy is for the getaway itself.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.guide: Get into the thick of it with Rhino tanks — the trophy's own description is the hint. Take on a Rhino (or drive one into a fight) and survive the encounter; the exact trigger is the tank itself, so go looking for one at a military site or a high wanted level.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alert, no wanted level from the job itself. Scout the store first, move when the staff are not looking, and leave before anyone notices.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. Bank vaults are the big robbery set-pieces — plan the getaway before you go in, because the escape counts: a vault robbed without a clean escape does not count.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 5 vaults

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — intercept one, crack it open, take the cash and get clear before the cops box you in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited, so use it to find the gaps — drive through every named area, including the small towns and the swamps, and the trophy pops when the last one registers.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 52 areas

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida — find one per gang, hit it, and get out. The gang matters, not the size of the take.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 9 gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view of the water and order a cocktail — a quiet moment trophy, and one of the few with no confirmed method published at launch, so treat the description literally: cocktail, Ocean Beach, view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Output Lag — no confirmed unlock method at launch for this trophy

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom front. Pick a showroom, get a fast car inside or lined up outside, and go through the glass. No confirmed step-by-step method is published yet, so the description itself is the guide.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Output Lag — no confirmed unlock method at launch for this trophy

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end. Bowling is also one of the activity types for Master of None, so this and that trophy go together.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method is published for this trophy at launch — its description, 'A partnership with mass appeal', points at a moment with your partner that draws a crowd. Play the partner content, keep an eye on public moments with Lucia or Jason, and check the guides linked here as players confirm the trigger.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Output Lag — no confirmed unlock method at launch; Sixshore — trophy guides updated as launch information comes in

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method is published for this trophy at launch. Its description — 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — points at the game's decision moments; make choices as they come and this should unlock as you play through them. Check the guides linked here as players confirm the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Output Lag — no confirmed unlock method at launch; Sixshore — trophy guides updated as launch information comes in

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then succeed at it the next time. The natural reading is a retry: fail a mission, challenge or activity, then pass it on the immediate retry. No confirmed method is published yet, so try a clean retry and see it pop.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Output Lag — no confirmed unlock method at launch for this trophy

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is the list's odd-one-out trophy — its description is a reaction, not an instruction. Leonida is full of random events and easter eggs; keep playing and exploring and it should trigger on something unexpected. No confirmed method is published yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Output Lag — no confirmed unlock method at launch for this trophy

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Line up a slow pass past a pedestrian, swing as you go by, and the trophy is for the drive-by itself. No confirmed step-by-step method is published yet, so the description is the guide.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Output Lag — no confirmed unlock method at launch for this trophy

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — pass them through your laundering contacts over time and the total adds up. Keep robbing and keep laundering; the count is cumulative.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, $250,000

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. It is cumulative across every shop, so just play and buy normally — weapons, clothes, food and cars all count — and the total will pass $100,000 long before the end of a full run.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, $100,000

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game money and give you somewhere to store vehicles — buy them as you earn, and check the property listings on the in-game map for the ones you still need.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 8 garages

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register vehicles you find or own — any 10 count — and the trophy pops at the tenth registration.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Press Start (18 Nov 2026) — full list; official list counts, 10 vehicles
